verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented bank-feed connection, payment-processor sync or payroll integration that flows activity into the ledger automatically. The customer payment options (iDEAL, direct debit, payment page) cover collecting payments, not syncing external systems into the books. The REST API, webhooks and MCP are developer building blocks, not the integration itself.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically
